title: FIDES Credential Catalog Schema
description: Schema for credential catalog entries. Provider profile is defined in the FIDES organization catalog; this file references it via orgId. Version 2 adds the ARF TS11 fields (formats[], schemaURIs[], rulebookIntegrity, trustedAuthorities[], attestationLoS, bindingType) as optional additions, so v1 files stay valid. Where a v2 field is absent the crawler derives it from the v1 singular fields. Canonical id is the attestation type (cred:org:key); legacy per-format ids live in aliasIds / formats[].credentialId — see docs/TS11-COMPLIANCE-PLAN.md §5.3.

$schema.description: v1 and v2 are both accepted. v2 signals that the file may use the TS11 fields; it changes nothing for files that do not.

orgId.description: Organization catalog id. Canonical provider name, DID, website, logo, and contact come from the organization catalog aggregated data.

id.description: Attestation type id (cred:org:key) or legacy per-format id (cred:org:key:format).

CredentialSectorCode.description: Must stay in sync with OrganizationSectorCode in fides-organization-catalog (organization-catalog.schema.json).

CredentialEcosystemCode.description: Closed ecosystem taxonomy for credential classification.

CredentialThemeCode.description: Cross-sector use-case themes for discovery (optional on each credential).

IntegrityHash.description: Subresource Integrity hash of the referenced document, as required by ARF TS11 for rulebooks and schemas. Format: sha256-<base64>.

SchemaURI.description: TS11 schemaURIs entry: one schema document per attestation format, because SD-JWT VC and mdoc encode the same attributes differently.

CredentialFormat.description: One attestation format of this attestation type. Use this on a v2 entry that covers several formats; a v1 entry per format keeps working and the crawler derives a single-element formats[] from vcFormat.

nativeIdentifier.description: vct for SD-JWT VC, docType for mdoc, type for VCDM.

credentialId.description: Legacy per-format catalog id for this format, kept so deep links published before the seed-merge keep resolving.

TrustedAuthority.description: TS11 TrustAuthority. Points at a registry in fides-trust-scheme-catalog by treg: identifier instead of encoding a bare URL, so the reference survives a registry moving house; the crawler resolves the URL. This is the one deliberate deviation from the TS11 TrustAuthority shape, see docs/TS11-ALIGNMENT.md.

frameworkType.description: TS11 frameworkType, identical to trustAnchorReferenceType in the trust scheme catalog and to type in OpenID4VP DCQL trusted_authorities.

registryId.description: Trust registry in fides-trust-scheme-catalog. The crawler resolves name, scheme and access level from there and fails on an unknown id.

schemeId.description: Optional; derived from the registry when omitted.

values.description: Concrete anchor values where they are public and stable, e.g. an Authority Key Identifier. Omit rather than guess.

CredentialCategoryCode.description: Optional top-level category for wallet-initiated issuance flow discovery.

id.description: Attestation type id: cred:<authorityCode>:<credentialKey>. Format is not part of the id; see formats[] and aliasIds (TS11-COMPLIANCE-PLAN §5.3).

aliasIds.description: Legacy per-format catalog ids (cred:org:key:format) that resolve to this attestation type.

rulebookUrl.description: TS11 rulebookURI: the human-readable Attestation Rulebook.

attestationTypeId.description: Attestation type this entry belongs to, without the format segment. Optional: the crawler derives it from the id. Set it explicitly when two entries with different keys are in fact the same attestation type.

formats.description: TS11 supported formats. Derived from vcFormat, nativeIdentifier, schemaUrl and schemaType when omitted.

schemaURIs.description: TS11 schemaURIs at attestation type level. Use formats[].schemaURIs when the schema differs per format.

trustedAuthorities.description: Trust registries a verifier can use to establish that an issuer of this attestation type is authorised.

attestationLoS.description: TS11 attestationLoS, using the ISO/IEC 18045 attack potential levels. Not the eIDAS assurance levels.

bindingType.description: TS11 bindingType: how the attestation binds to its holder.

sectors.description: One or more sectors from the same closed list as the organization catalog.

ecosystems.description: One or more ecosystems this credential type is associated with.

themes.description: Optional use-case themes for discovery and filtering (orthogonal to sectors/ecosystems).
